item.body:
Type: Bug When selecting all the text within a large file and asking copilot to do some transformation (like translating it), it will get the first lines done then crop the rest of the file. The length depends on the model, Gemini models being the exception so far. comments.body:
/needsMoreInfo

Please try this again. A lot of work has gone into inline chat and we now have access to better models. When still seeing this, use the Chat Debug view and please share the request log (F1 > Open View > Chat Debug).

This issue has been closed as it has been labeled with `info-needed` and has not received the additional information that was requested from the issue author. It has been labeled as `info-needed` for 7 days.
